after.missing-ch-creator-insight: Only visits to an app's page in the catalog are counted, not the use of the app itself, and only the platform owner sees the totals.

after.missing-ch-feedback: A click opens a prepared e-mail from the sender's own account; thanks and feedback arrive, but they are neither anonymous nor counted, and recommendations are not recorded.
after.missing-ch-creator-insight: Thanks reach the creator only if the platform owner passes them on.
